title: Analysis.
officialText:
A rational analysis supporting the types of smoke control systems to be employed, their methods of operation, the
systems supporting them and the methods of construction to be utilized shall accompany the submitted construction documents
and shall include, but not be limited to, the items indicated in Sections 909.4.1 through 909.4.6. The basis of design and design
analysis of the smoke control system shall be submitted to the department.
